q: Which operational definition is most complete for a deceleration target?
choices: A. 'Aggression: any action that harms another person or appears intended to cause them harm'
B. 'Aggression: hand or foot contact with a person; onset at contact, offset after 3 s without contact'
C. 'Aggression: hitting — the client strikes another person with an open or closed hand'
D. 'Aggression: hitting, kicking, or biting others, or any other behavior of a similar aggressive character'
